title: gi-dellav/zerostack
claim: gi-dellav/zerostack — Lightweight coding agent written in Rust, optimized for memory footprint and performance
why_good: A lightweight, memory-optimized Rust coding agent — appeals to devs on constrained machines, but another entrant in a crushed field.
value: No clear paid wedge; 'lighter coding agent' rarely converts to revenue against free, funded incumbents.
risk: Brutal coding-agent category (Claude Code/Cursor/Aider); 'lightweight' alone isn't a business.

zh.claim: gi-dellav/zerostack —— 用 Rust 写的轻量编码 agent,针对内存占用和性能优化。
zh.why_good: 一个轻量、内存优化的 Rust 编码 agent——对受限机器的开发者有吸引力,但它是被碾压赛道里的又一个入局者。
zh.value: 没有清晰的付费切口;更轻的编码 agent 很难在免费、有融资的对手前变现。
zh.risk: 残酷的编码 agent 品类(Claude Code/Cursor/Aider);光 轻量 不是生意。
